contracts.typed_filter: Immutable CostMatch disjunction layered on unchanged SacrificeFilter; shared actual/projected evaluation
contracts.selection: Ranged groups choose incrementally, freeze exact incarnations on Finish, no optional powerset enumeration
contracts.lotus: One or more artifacts, source tap may precede its own sacrifice, only actual sacrifices count including replacement to exile; targeted player receives three of one chosen color per actual sacrifice; controller chooses; uses the stack
contracts.winter: Zero or more own artifact graveyard cards; frozen declared selection count is X even if replacement prevents/redirects an event; actual exile count retained separately
contracts.sideswipe: Frozen predeparture actual sacrifice Vehicle fact; exile replacement preserves sacrifice qualification; all-illegal-target spell does not draw
contracts.payment: Distinct departure components cannot consume the same source, duplicate incarnations are rejected, removal of a graveyard exile prohibition by funding is projected before final payment
